facts_from_repo.campaign1_render_time: 4 renders of the 38 s video in 5.8 min = about 1.45 min each (agent/docs/CAMPAIGN_LEARNINGS.md line 71; agent/state/outreach/assets/render_r2.log). The playbook's '5 min' is the older figure; the appendix of CAMPAIGN_LEARNINGS says to plan 2-5 min until re-measured.
facts_from_repo.word_timing: The speech-to-text step is English only; for Gujarati the plan uses per-scene captions, not word by word (agent/state/outreach/master_voice_gu_v1.md; agent/video/toolpaths.py). A Hindi cut works the same way: scene lengths come from the length of each voice clip.
facts_from_repo.renderer_limits: agent/video/render_master.py hardcodes 5 scene segments in the audio join (if k < 4) and reads words from timeline.json; it renders sequentially into one shared frames_tmp folder. A 4-scene Hindi cut needs a small adaptation.
facts_from_repo.ai_voice: ElevenLabs free-plan audio is not commercially usable; a paid plan with the commercial licence is needed, and an AI-voice disclosure (agent/docs/AGENTIC_SALES_BLUEPRINT.md lines 55 and 80). Plan price not checked.
facts_from_repo.campaign1_delivery: 2 of 7 cold WhatsApp templates arrived on time (agent/docs/CAMPAIGN1_DIAGNOSIS_2026-10-20.md, section 2 item 4)
facts_from_repo.campaign1_rework: 2 of 6 wave-2 renders were rework because of a wrong name slot (CAMPAIGN_LEARNINGS C7)

options_compared.recommendation: Option A first. The cost of B is small in hours, but there is no evidence that it changes the outcome, and delivery (2 of 7 cold templates on time) and reader identity (RERA numbers often reach an operator) decide more than the name in the video. Re-decide after the first 50 sends, using page-open, play and 75 percent view beacons, not replies (too few replies to compare). Spend a per-builder render only on the top 10 owner-level leads if the master video shows real watch-through.
options_compared.why_not_an_a_b_test: At a few percent reply rate, 10 vs 10 builders cannot show a difference. Campaign 1 had an effective n of 1 to 4.
